title: Story
description: A published choose-your-own-adventure story in one language: content/stories/<id>/story/<lang>.json, with its text, graph, endings and asset references. Every language of a story is its own complete file with the same structure (node ids, kinds, links, images, ending kinds); only the words differ. The single definition of the format, shared by the pipeline (tools/) and the app's tests. See docs/story-format.md. Rules that JSON Schema can't express (reachability, no cycles, budgets, every language matching the first) are checked by `story check`.

id.description: Stable story id, also the folder name.

version.description: Bumped on every publish, in every language at once.

language.description: The language of this file, the same as its file name.

translatedFrom.description: Only in a translation: the story's first language, the one it was written in. The first language's own file has none.

cover.description: Image id of the cover (portrait 3:4, no text: the app draws the title).

nodes.description: Node id -> node. Ids never change once a version is published: progress is keyed by them.

text.description: A text, in this file's language.

page.description: A plain page: text, illustration, one next node.

fork.description: A page that ends with a question and exactly two options (A and B).

ending.description: A final page. Its illustration doubles as the ending's badge (circle crop).
